taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Android deep-link transaction and authenticated action binding
controls.source_trace: Trace external link fields into account selection and sensitive operations, including links opened before login and replayed after account changes.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve the receiving component and parse route parameters before identifying the authenticated consumer. Authentication of the app user does not authorize every link-selected object or action. A link that merely opens a confirmation screen is not a committed action; compare the final server transaction and any one-time nonce/account binding.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local app/test account fixture and benign action; compare an intended link with another owned account/transaction identifier.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Opening a screen is not execution of a protected action; a required confirmation may already enforce the intended policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind pending action to current identity and transaction, retesting login transitions, replay and legitimate navigation.
